_comment: wave 29 (gap-closing batch 5): base+temporal constructors, geometry array accessors, a spanset accessor, and the tcbuffer radius set. tpoint_from_base_temp / tgeo_from_base_temp take a geometry primary and a temporal extra (wkb_temporal), returning a Temporal* via temporal_wkb. geo_pointarr / geo_stboxes return heap arrays over the existing array_out machinery (ptr for GSERIALIZED**, span_val for the contiguous STBox*). spanset_span_n returns the i-th span (intspan_text). tcbuffer_radius returns the radius Set (floatset_text) — on the v15 pin it returns a Set (the earlier v11-lineage tfloat drift is gone). All probed green against v15.

operators.comment_one_liner: tpoint_from_base_temp (Temporal *) - a temporal point from a geometry and a temporal's time frame.
tgeo_from_base_temp (Temporal *) - a temporal geo from a geometry and a temporal's time frame.
geo_pointarr (GSERIALIZED **) - the array of points of a geometry.
geo_stboxes (STBox *) - the array of spatiotemporal boxes of a (multi)line geometry.
spanset_span_n (Span *) - the n-th span of a span set.
